Name: Bunnies that actually hop
Author: Feathercatch
Description:
I thought instead of shuffling along, the bunnies would look considerably better hopping. You know, that thing that bunnies do. ;p

I based the side view on the wild rabbit you see in the out-world (thus the light gray color). I made the baby bunnies a lighter shade of gray for a more immediate visual difference when compared to the adults.

Feel free to edit the file to suit any of your preferences!
